name: flush-index
path: /{{ spans_index | default('otel_spans') }},{{ logs_index | default('otel_logs') }},{{ metrics_index | default('otel_metrics') }}/_flush

body.query: source={{ spans_index | default('otel_spans') }} | stats count() as value by span(startTime, 1m) as ts, serviceName | sort ts

source={{ spans_index | default('otel_spans') }} | where kind = 'SPAN_KIND_SERVER' or kind = 'SPAN_KIND_CONSUMER' | eval satisfied = if(durationInNanos <= 500000000, 1, 0), tolerating = if(durationInNanos > 500000000 and durationInNanos <= 2000000000, 1, 0) | stats count() as total, sum(satisfied) as s, sum(tolerating) as t by serviceName | eval apdex = round((s + t * 0.5) / total, 4) | sort apdex

source={{ spans_index | default('otel_spans') }} | where serviceName = 'frontend' and kind = 'SPAN_KIND_SERVER' | eval affected = if(durationInNanos > 100000000, 1, 0) | stats count() as total, sum(affected) as affected by name | eventstats sum(total) as all_total, sum(affected) as all_affected | eval rate = round(cast(affected as double) / total, 4), overall_rate = round(cast(all_affected as double) / all_total, 4) | where total >= 20 | sort - rate | head 20
source = {{ spans_index | default('otel_spans') }} | stats distinct_count(traceId) as trace_count by serviceName | sort - trace_count
source = {{ spans_index | default('otel_spans') }} | stats count() as span_count by traceId | sort - span_count | head 20
source = {{ spans_index | default('otel_spans') }} | where serviceName = 'checkout' and endTime >= '2026-10-16 06:40:00' | stats count() as cnt
source = {{ spans_index | default('otel_spans') }} | sort - startTime | head 50
source={{ spans_index | default('otel_spans') }} | where events.name = 'exception' | stats count() as spans_with_exception by span(startTime, 1m) as t_min, serviceName | sort t_min, serviceName
source = {{ logs_index | default('otel_logs') }} | where traceId = "59c5c193c46bf6d736d615d2a5ca8001" | head 1000
source={{ logs_index | default('otel_logs') }} | eval ts = eventTime | stats count() as count by span(ts, 1m) as t, severityText | sort t
source={{ logs_index | default('otel_logs') }} | where upper(severityText) in ('ERROR', 'WARN', 'WARNING') | eval ts = eventTime | stats count() as value by span(ts, 1m) as t, serviceName | sort t
source = {{ logs_index | default('otel_logs') }} | where time >= '2026-10-15 16:40:00' and time <= '2026-10-15 21:40:00' | where severityNumber >= 17 | sort - time | head 100

source={{ logs_index | default('otel_logs') }} | where match(body, 'order placed', operator='AND') and serviceName = 'checkout' and eventTime >= '2026-10-15 21:00:00' and eventTime < '2026-10-15 21:30:00' | sort - eventTime | fields eventTime, serviceName, severityText, body | head 100
source={{ logs_index | default('otel_logs') }} | where match(body, 'connect redis', operator='AND') | stats count() as c
source={{ logs_index | default('otel_logs') }} | where match(body, 'GET') and eventTime >= '2026-10-15 21:00:00' and eventTime <= '2026-10-16 06:50:00' | sort - eventTime | head 100
source={{ logs_index | default('otel_logs') }} | where ilike(body, '%redis%') | eval ts = eventTime | sort - ts | head 100 | fields ts, serviceName, severityText, body

source={{ logs_index | default('otel_logs') }} | where serviceName = 'cart' and isnotnull(body) and not like(body, '%ValkeyCartStore%') and not like(body, '%called with userId%') | patterns body | stats count() as n by patterns_field | sort - n | head 20

source = {{ logs_index | default('otel_logs') }} | where serviceName = 'frontend-proxy' | parse body '^\[(?<ts>[^\]]+)\] "(?<method>\S+) (?<path>\S+) (?<proto>[^"]+)" (?<status>\d{3}) (?<flags>\S+) (?<details>\S+) (?<term>\S+) "(?<ufr>[^"]*)" (?<rx>\d+) (?<tx>\d+) (?<dur>\d+) [\s\S]+' | eval d = cast(dur as int) | stats count() as n, avg(d) as avg_ms, percentile(d, 95) as p95_ms, max(d) as max_ms by method, path | sort - n, method, path | head 20
source={{ logs_index | default('otel_logs') }} | sort - eventTime | head 1000
source = {{ logs_index | default('otel_logs') }} | head 10
source = {{ logs_index | default('otel_logs') }} | sort - eventTime | head 10
source = {{ logs_index | default('otel_logs') }} serviceName="product-reviews" | sort - eventTime | head 10
source = {{ logs_index | default('otel_logs') }} | where serviceName = 'kafka' | head 10
source = {{ logs_index | default('otel_logs') }} serviceName="product-reviews" | where eventTime >= '2026-10-15 23:00:00' and eventTime < '2026-10-16 00:35:00' | head 10
source = {{ spans_index | default('otel_spans') }} | where durationInNanos >= 20000000 and durationInNanos <= 200000000 | head 10
source = {{ spans_index | default('otel_spans') }} | sort - durationInNanos | head 10
source = {{ logs_index | default('otel_logs') }} | stats count() by span(eventTime, 1h)

source = {{ spans_index | default('otel_spans') }} | eval latency_band = case(durationInNanos < 1000000, 'a_lt_1ms', durationInNanos >= 1000000 and durationInNanos < 10000000, 'b_1_10ms', durationInNanos >= 10000000 and durationInNanos < 100000000, 'c_10_100ms', durationInNanos >= 100000000 and durationInNanos < 1000000000, 'd_100ms_1s', durationInNanos >= 1000000000 and durationInNanos < 10000000000, 'e_1_10s', durationInNanos >= 10000000000, 'f_ge_10s') | stats count() by latency_band
source = {{ spans_index | default('otel_spans') }} | where eventTime >= '2026-10-16 02:00:00' and eventTime < '2026-10-16 02:10:00' | stats count() by serviceName, kind | sort - `count()` | head 10

source = {{ spans_index | default('otel_spans') }} | where eventTime >= '2026-10-16 01:00:00' and eventTime < '2026-10-16 01:20:00' | stats count() by serviceName, kind | sort - serviceName, + kind | head 10
source = {{ spans_index | default('otel_spans') }} | stats dc(traceId)
source = {{ logs_index | default('otel_logs') }} | where query_string(['body'], 'telescope binoculars score') | head 10

source = {{ metrics_index | default('otel_metrics') }} | where kind = 'GAUGE' | stats count() as points, latest(value, eventTime) as last_value, max(eventTime) as last_seen by name | sort - points | head 10
source = {{ spans_index | default('otel_spans') }} | stats count() as spans
source = {{ spans_index | default('otel_spans') }} | stats count() as spans by traceId, serviceName | head 10

source = {{ spans_index | default('otel_spans') }} | eval d1 = durationInNanos - 1, d2 = durationInNanos - 2, d3 = durationInNanos - 3 | stats count() as c by durationInNanos, d1, d2, d3 | sort - c | head 10

source = {{ spans_index | default('otel_spans') }} | where serviceName = 'cart' and name in ('HGET', 'HMSET', 'EXPIRE', 'POST /oteldemo.CartService/GetCart', 'POST /oteldemo.CartService/AddItem', 'POST /oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart') | stats count() as pv by name, span(startTime, 1m) as minute | sort - pv | head 10 from 100
source = {{ spans_index | default('otel_spans') }} | eval m = minute(startTime) | stats count() as c by traceId, m, name | sort - c | head 10
source={{ spans_index | default('otel_spans') }} | where serviceName = 'frontend' | stats count() as value by span(startTime, 1m) as ts | stats avg(value) as avg_count

source = {{ logs_index | default('otel_logs') }} | eval len = length(body) | stats count() as logs, avg(len) as avg_len, max(len) as max_len, sum(len) as bytes by serviceName | where logs > 1000 | sort - bytes

source={{ metrics_index | default('otel_metrics') }} | where kind = 'HISTOGRAM' | mvexpand bucketCountsList | where bucketCountsList > 0 | stats count() as nonempty_bucket_entries by name | sort - nonempty_bucket_entries, name | head 10

source={{ logs_index | default('otel_logs') }} | stats dc(severityNumber) as sev_numbers, dc(severityText) as sev_labels, values(severityText) as labels by serviceName | where sev_labels > 1 | eval label_list = mvjoin(labels, ',') | sort - sev_labels, serviceName
source={{ spans_index | default('otel_spans') }} | stats count() as spans, dc(durationInNanos) as distinct_durations by serviceName | sort - spans

source={{ metrics_index | default('otel_metrics') }} | stats dc(time) as export_timestamps, count() as points, min(time) as first_export, max(time) as last_export by serviceName | sort export_timestamps, serviceName
source={{ spans_index | default('otel_spans') }} | stats count() as spans, distinct_count_approx(traceId) as traces by span(startTime, 1m) as minute | sort minute
